simplebatchupload-buttonlabel: Dooro faylasha (ama halkan ku soo jiid)...
simplebatchupload-desc: Waxay oggolaanaysaa in faylal badan si fudud hal mar loo soo geliyo
simplebatchupload-error-rename-pattern: Qaabka +rename ma aha tibaax joogto ah oo sax ah.
simplebatchupload-estimate-minutes: Waxaa ka haray $1 {{PLURAL:$1|daqiiqo|daqiiqadood}} xadka heerka soo gelinta ee wikitigan.
simplebatchupload-estimate-under-a-minut: Wax ka yar hal daqiiqo ayaa ka hartay xadka heerka soo gelinta ee wikigan.
simplebatchupload-max-files-reached: Waxaa lagu daray $1 oo ka mid ah $2 {{PLURAL:$2|faylka|faylasha}} la doortay. Wax intaas ka badan lama dari karo ilaa soo gelinta hadda socota ay dhammaato.
simplebatchupload-result-rate-limit-stop: La joojiyay: xadka heerka soo gelinta ee wikigan ayaa si isdaba joog ah loo gaadhay. Mar kale dooro faylasha haray marka xadku dib u bilaabmo.
simplebatchupload-result-unknown-error: Server-ku wuxuu soo celiyay jawaab aan la filayn.
simplebatchupload-warning-duplicate: Nuqul ka mid ah {{PLURAL:$2|faylka jira|faylasha jira}} $1.
simplebatchupload-warning-exists: Waxaa lagu dul qoray faylka jiray $1.
simplebatchupload-warning-no-change: Hore ayuu wikigan ugu jiray isagoo leh nuxur isku mid ah.
